SELECT sc.id, sc.course_selection_id, sc.score_value, sc.status, sc.published_at, sc.created_at, sc.updated_at FROM score sc JOIN course_selection cs ON cs.id = sc.course_selection_id WHERE cs.teaching_class_id = #{value} ORDER BY sc.id ASC

SELECT sc.id, sc.course_selection_id, sc.score_value, sc.status, sc.published_at, sc.created_at, sc.updated_at FROM score sc JOIN course_selection cs ON cs.id = sc.course_selection_id JOIN teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cs.teaching_class_id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND tc.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND sc.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY sc.published_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (course_selection_id, score_value, status) VALUES (#{courseSelectionId}, #{scoreValue}, #{status})
